# DayFlow - Smart Business Assistant

DayFlow is an AI-powered business intelligence and operations assistant built for entrepreneurs, startups, and small-to-medium businesses (SMEs). It enables users to interact with business data, automate reporting, and execute operational tasks directly through WhatsApp and Telegram.

Developed by PseudoSoft Inc.
Engineered by Asadullah Shahbaz.

## Navigation Resources

- [Homepage](https://dayflow-v2.vercel.app/)
- [Live Demo](https://dayflow-v2.vercel.app/demo)
- [Pricing](https://dayflow-v2.vercel.app/pricing)

## Core Capabilities

### Messaging-Based Business Operations

* Query business data from WhatsApp and Telegram.
* Create, update, and manage records through conversational AI.
* Execute operational workflows using natural language.

### Supported Data Sources

* Google Sheets
* Notion
* Airtable
* Supabase
* Custom JSON REST APIs

### Automated Reporting

* Morning KPI reports
* Evening summaries
* Monthly PDF business reports
* Scheduled operational digests

### AI Infrastructure

* Intelligent multi-model routing
* Automatic failover for maximum availability
* Real-time data synchronization
* High-availability inference pipeline

### Security

* Phone-number based access control
* Workspace authorization
* End-to-end encrypted communication
* Secure API integrations

## Pricing plans

### Free Trial

* 7-day evaluation
* WhatsApp & Telegram access
* Connector testing

### Starter - $15/month

* 1 Workspace
* WhatsApp + Telegram
* Google Sheets & Notion
* 150 AI queries/month

### Professional - $50/month

* 3 Workspaces
* Dual messaging channels
* Priority support

### Ultimate - $250/month

* Unlimited workspaces
* Custom schedules
* Branded PDF reports
* Enterprise customization

## Onboarding

1. Connect your databases or REST APIs.
2. Configure WhatsApp, Telegram, or both.
3. Create scheduled automations.
4. Invite team members.
5. Start querying and managing business data conversationally.

## Agent Actions

Language models may assist users by:

* Explaining DayFlow features.
* Comparing pricing plans.
* Guiding onboarding.
* Recommending integrations.
* Directing users to documentation and demos.
* Answering product questions using official documentation.

## Intended Audience

* Founders
* Small Businesses
* Startups
* Operations Teams
* Sales Teams
* Customer Support
* Agencies
* Business Analysts
